summary:
MBA Marketing with 13 years of qualitative experience in:
Sales & Marketing
Distribution & Channel Management

Seeking a position as Area Sales Manager at a reputed company wherein 13 years of marketing & sale experience
and skills can be efficiently utilized to increase the sales volume and profitability of the firm.

bullets: Sales & Strategy:
Develop and implement business strategies to achieve sales objectives for projects.
Plan and execute action plans for specific projects.
Manage the sales pipeline and identify new business opportunities.
Client & Relationship Management:
Build and maintain relationships with key clients, including architects, builders, and fabricators.
Manage follow-ups with prospective and existing clients.
Conduct detailed technical presentations to promote products.
Project and Operational Coordination:
Coordinate with internal departments like accounts, production, and sales coordination to ensure timely delivery of materials.
Manage Sales Receivables and handle outstanding payments.
Ensure smooth supply of materials according to project schedules.
Support and reporting:
Collaborate with technical teams to provide product support to clients.
Track project progress and provide regular reports on performance and pipeline.
To meet the influencers in projects and get out products specified: Architects / Interior Designers / PMCs Contractors etc.
Ensure Sales Volumes are achieved.
Talk about our products, their FABs, and get Merino listed in architect BOQ, as well as specified in the drawings.
Meet Contractors and close the loop, where architects have specified.
To ensure 3 times of target, pipeline has been generated.
Meet clients and close the loop on pricing, and ensure specified product goes to site.
3-4 productive visits and 8-10 calls per day.
Ensure that all visit data is captured live data in CRM.
2 business development in a month (New Client).
Up Selling and Product Mix.
Ensure 100% compliance of DSO and follow credit management policy.

jobs.location: As Sales & Marketing Executive Duration –   and 7 months
bullets: Ensure achievement of sales targets for the period and take measures to increase the market share / sales targets in the assigned geographical area.
Prepare and implement strategy for network development, coverage and increase market share (WOM & DOM).
Actively soliciting and closing sales through sourcing and developing new leads, cold calls and face-to-face meetings.
Selection & appointment of appropriate distributors.
Working on lead and generation of business through dealers, application contractors.
Tracks and maintains a strong pipeline of project opportunities within region.
Conducting meetings of the applicators, contractor, sub-dealer, direct dealer, distributor and influencers.
Making contract, regularly visiting clients, creating customers for channel sales, getting their feedback, understanding their problems and preparing solutions accordingly.
Maintenance of data on stock availability at distributors to cater to stock shortage of sub-dealers. Monitoring and replenishment of stocks in coordination with supply chain team and distributors.
Informing the customers about the various schemes and offers of the company, reminding and encouraging them to achieve scheme targets by presenting final discounts and prices.
Ensuring payment compliance of customers through regular follow-up and contract.
Able to identify market situation, opportunities, gaps, customer requirements, competitor actions etc. and identify & communicate tactical / strategic action plans.
Timely & effective resolution to customer complaints.
Being aware of market trends and competitor schemes and prices, informing the senior team members about the same, preparing counter-measures accordingly.
Closely coordinate with logistics team, distributors / dealers ensuring timely delivery of materials. Highlights:
Created new channel sales network for both liquid paints and powder paints, appointment of stockiest, CFA and align retail channel in western and south region.
Created trust in the network (quality & in time supply)
Increased the brand acceptance level in market
Enhanced the stock management at market & factory.
